Today, I went flatfish downshot fishing at Taean Eoeundol Port with two friends from my hometown. It was still dark, so we waited for sunrise at the inner harbor before heading to the fishing point. We arrived at the last point we visited on our last fishing trip and started downshot fishing for flatfish. We caught flatfish and rockfish, then moved on to Refrigerator Point. On our first cast, a 7-inch flatfish suddenly bit. The bite was incredibly satisfying. As expected from a large flatfish, the sashimi was delicious. Today's catch was the largest I've ever caught, excluding boat trips, so I think it'll be a memorable day.

오늘은 아내와 함께 차박 겸 카약낚시를 하러 어은돌항으로 왔다. 거의 4개월만에 출조인데 그동안 쇼핑몰 업무로 낚시 일정을 잡기 어려웠었다. 너무 낚시를 오래 쉬어서 시간을 내어 바다로 나와봤다. 항에 도착해서 먼저 카약을 세팅하고 아내와 산책도 하고 저녁시간을 보냈다. 아직 밤 기온이 낮아서 그냥 차박을 하기엔 춥다. 그래서 온수 히터를 틀고 하루를 보냈다. 다음날 자고 있는 아내를 차에 두고 낚시를 나갔다. 예전에 왔던 포인트 주변에서 낚시를 시작했는데 입질이 없어서 더 깊은 곳으로 이동하며 어군을 찾아다녔다. 결국 어군을 발견하고 손맛을 볼 수 있었다. 오늘 낚은 우럭은 에어프라이어로 구워서 맛있게 먹었다.

en-US.title: [Season 23] Ice fishing in Jichoncheon, where large icefish are caught one after another!
en-US.description:
KUKUMIN Shopping Mall ▶ http://kukumin.com
Global Shop (KR, EN, JP, TW, VN, PH) ▶ https://kukumin.shop

Today, I went ice fishing in Chuncheon for the first time in a while. This season, the ice froze quickly, but the smelt weren't coming, so I searched the internet and found a spot with good fishing conditions. This spot was already famous, so many people were already fishing. I found a spot in the middle of the ice and checked the bottom with my fish finder. The water was about 4 meters deep, and I spotted a single smelt. I decided to fish here, so I dug a hole with an ice chisel and set up a cube tent over it. I cast a net to catch some smelt and started fishing. The fish were good, averaging over 10cm in size. After fishing, I made some rice cake dumpling soup and left. I brought the smelt home and enjoyed it as fried smelt.
